name: Jonathan Skrmetti
stance: Opposes a federal moratorium on state AI laws and presses AI companies on child safety.

statements.text: Co-led the 40-AG letter asking Congress to reject the 10-year moratorium on state AI enforcement.
AI tools can radically reshape our world for the better, but they can also present threats to kids that are more immediate, more personal, and more dangerous than any prior technology.
Led the bipartisan 44-AG letter to AI companies saying they must prioritize child safety.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
